description: Suno Studio effect. Softens hard key attacks, applies a warm tilt EQ, adds light saturation, and lifts air for a rounded piano or electric-piano tone. Apply to the rendered KEYS stem inside Suno Studio; this is not a lyric tag.

metadata.description: Suno Studio effect. Softens hard key attacks, applies a warm tilt EQ, adds light saturation, and lifts air for a rounded piano or electric-piano tone.

warmth/tilt.description: Single tilt control: boosts lows near 250Hz and cuts highs near 5kHz (or the reverse when negative).
warmth/tilt.label: Warmth

attack soften.description: Rounds hard note transients by blending toward an envelope-smoothed version of the signal.
attack soften.label: Soften

saturation.description: Light drive into the tanh stage for gentle harmonic warmth.
saturation.label: Sat

air.description: High-shelf lift near 10kHz for open top end.
air.label: Air

dry/wet mix.description: Blend between dry input and processed signal.
dry/wet mix.label: Mix

bypass.description: Pass the dry signal through unprocessed.
bypass.label: Bypass
